title: Predictors of Brain Tumor-Associated Epilepsy: A Retrospective Cohort Study
summary: This retrospective study investigates which characteristics in brain tumor patients are associated with an increased risk of epileptic seizures. To this end, routine medical data from approximately 10,000 patients will be analyzed. The goal is to identify risk factors in order to improve future predictions of who is particularly at risk and to assess whether preventive treatment might be beneficial.
conditions: ICD-10 codes C71.- and C72.- (primary CNS tumors), as well as C79.3 and C79.4 (secondary CNS tumors)
Malignant neoplasm of spinal cord, cranial nerves and other parts of central nervous system
Secondary malignant neoplasm of brain and cerebral meninges
Secondary malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified parts of nervous system

interventions.name: All patients treated at the Department of Neurology at Heidelberg University Hospital with a tumor of the central nervous system (CNS), for whom data are available between January 1, 2000, and May 21, 2025, will be included. This patient cohort is defined by the presence of ICD-10 codes C71.- and C7
